expressions.title: The Karachi Indecent Advertisement Prohibition Act, 1951
expressions.title_basis: p1 block 2363897 prints 'ACT No. XXXVI OF 1951'; s.1 names it; ss.1-10 complete. The p1 head (an earlier Act's s.3) is a fragment. ACT No. XXXVII (Control of Shipping (Amendment) Act, 1951) and ACT No. XXXVIII (Indian Tolls (Army and Air Force) (Amendment) Act, 1951) on p3: the second is cut off after s.1 at the end of the copy; the first's sections are fused by the text layer into one block with OCR loss. Both are set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split'), to be added from a better copy.
